attributes.name: data-ae-overflow-marquee

Loads Anchor for placement. Starts only when visible; hover and focus pause in place. Root reduced motion keeps ellipsis; desktop overflow receives a native title unless authored.

attributes.name: data-ae-preference

attributes.name: data-ae-present
attributes.description: Present container. Empty disables motion; all expands to opacity transform height width. Property tokens are whitespace-separated.

attributes.name: data-ae-present-active
attributes.description: Selected member's native ID, without #. An empty value selects no member. Invalid or ambiguous selection preserves the previous selection.

attributes.name: data-ae-present-group
attributes.description: Coordinates nested Present members by their native IDs. Nested groups own their own members.

attributes.name: data-ae-present-motion

attributes.name: data-ae-present-target
attributes.description: One mounted Present element ID, optionally prefixed with #. Empty requests pop on the closest Present of each resolved message/transform target, once per distinct element. Omitted makes no Present request. Requires initialized Present.

attributes.name: data-ae-present-when
attributes.description: One class token on the Present Group that selects this member when no explicit active attribute is present.

attributes.name: data-ae-prev
attributes.description: Cycles backward through the enclosing preference's built-in values; use a keyboard-operable control.

attributes.name: data-ae-scrollbar-vertical

attributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox

attributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-fade-state

attributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-momentum

attributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-snap
attributes.description: Snap axis on an element that also declares Scrollbox. Empty is horizontal; false disables Snap. Snap loads the Scrollbox dependency itself.

attributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-wheel-horizontal

attributes.name: data-ae-snap-item
attributes.description: Snap alignment for an item belonging to the nearest Scrollbox. Left/top alias start; right/bottom alias end; empty is center.

attributes.name: data-ae-target
attributes.description: One Present target ID, optionally prefixed with #; CSS selector lists are not accepted.

attributes.name: data-ae-theme-color
attributes.description: Marker on the runtime-managed theme-color meta tag.

attributes.name: data-ae-transform-target
attributes.description: One element ID, optionally prefixed with #, receiving feedback classes and motion. Omitted uses the boundary itself.

attributes.name: data-ae-trigger
attributes.description: Present action. Target is one native ID, or the closest Present ancestor when omitted. Prefer a native button for keyboard activation.

attributes.name: data-ae-trigger-on
attributes.description: Use hover for delegated pointer hover opening/closing. Touch and keyboard activation keep click behavior.

attributes.name: data-ae-unpop-on-outside
attributes.description: Set false to keep a Present region open when clicking outside it.

attributes.name: data-ae-viewport
attributes.description: Observes the nearest native scroll container, or the document. Publishes normalized position on the selected axes and a geometric visible area fraction. Empty and both select both axes; invalid values warn and fall back to both.

attributes.name: data-ae-viewport-target
attributes.description: Publishes CSS outputs on one existing element ID, optionally prefixed with #, instead of the observed element. Geometry and events remain on the observer. Retargeting restores previous inline styles; conflicting Viewport writers are rejected.

attributes.name: data-ae-wait-mounted

attributes.name: data-ae-weak-style
attributes.description: Internal runtime marker; applications should not configure this attribute.

events.name: AelluxJsViewportChange
events.description: Relevant geometry change, including the first measurable publication. Bubbling, composed and noncancelable on the observed element. detail: { viewport, x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y, visible, state, measurable, previous, initial }. Coordinates are unclamped physical values; CSS position outputs stay in -2..2. Unknown geometry uses null coordinates/state and visible: 0; only Change reports its loss after a valid publication. previous is an independent snapshot of the last published geometry.

events.name: AelluxJsViewportError
events.description: Scheduled failure on document. detail: { operation: 'refresh' or 'unmount', reference, elements, error }. Automatic work is observed; direct refresh callers retain rejection.

events.name: AelluxJsViewportFullyInside
events.description: Transition to complete containment, including an initial matching measurable state. Bubbling, composed and noncancelable on the observed element. detail: { viewport, x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y, visible, state, measurable, previous, initial }. Coordinates are unclamped physical values; CSS position outputs stay in -2..2. Unknown geometry uses null coordinates/state and visible: 0; only Change reports its loss after a valid publication. previous is an independent snapshot of the last published geometry.

events.name: AelluxJsViewportFullyOutside
events.description: Transition to zero positive-area intersection, including an initial matching measurable state. Bubbling, composed and noncancelable on the observed element. detail: { viewport, x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y, visible, state, measurable, previous, initial }. Coordinates are unclamped physical values; CSS position outputs stay in -2..2. Unknown geometry uses null coordinates/state and visible: 0; only Change reports its loss after a valid publication. previous is an independent snapshot of the last published geometry.
